findings.evidenceJa: 倍の鋭さで反撃してくる
findings.governingReading: She lightly parries Shirou and returns a counter twice as keen or fast.
findings.explanation: Saber’s counterattack being twice as sharp becomes being far more effective.

findings.highlight: The way you struck at me so fiercely and determinedly amazed me
findings.evidenceJa: まっすぐに打ち込んでくる太刀だけは目を見張るモノ
findings.governingReading: Only the force of his customary straight-on strikes had been impressive; this morning lacks that power.
findings.explanation: Saber’s praise of Shirou’s straight drive and its power becomes broad praise of fierce determination.

findings.evidenceJa: 今朝の鍛錬は苛烈を極めた。
findings.governingReading: The morning practice is described as having become maximally harsh.
findings.explanation: Training reaching an extreme of severity becomes merely a rough morning.

findings.highlight: you also shut off your emotions in battle
findings.evidenceJa: 凛とて戦闘時には情を捨てる筈
findings.governingReading: Saber says Rin too should cast off personal feeling or sentiment in combat; Rin then clarifies that she discards only softness.
findings.explanation: Rin discarding 情 in battle becomes shutting off all emotions.

findings.highlight: I don't see things in such logical, abstract terms as you do
findings.evidenceJa: 貴女ほど達観はできない
findings.governingReading: Rin says she cannot be as detached, resigned, or philosophically beyond ordinary feeling as Saber.
findings.explanation: Rin’s inability to attain Saber’s detached transcendence becomes not thinking in logical, abstract terms.

findings.highlight: slam my knife down onto the cutting board as if it were a hammer
findings.evidenceJa: まな板に包丁を突き立てる
findings.governingReading: In obvious agitation he repeatedly plants or slams the knife blade into the board.
findings.explanation: Shirou driving the knife into the cutting board becomes using it like a hammer.

findings.evidenceJa: そっちの体も落ち着いてるみたい
findings.governingReading: She says Shirou’s body appears to have settled down.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は部屋から出ていく。
findings.governingReading: Rin simply leaves the room after setting Shirou the lamp task.
findings.explanation: The room Rin exits is assigned to Rin.

findings.governingReading: Because of the preceding night’s events and failures, Shirou feels he must make at least one or two attempts succeed this time.
findings.explanation: “Given how last night went” becomes “It’s only been a night.”

findings.highlight: maybe five looked like they'd been infused with magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 五つのランプにはうまく魔力が通っていた
findings.governingReading: Among the unchanged lamps, five definitely had magical energy pass through them successfully; this is not yet completed Strengthening.
findings.explanation: Five lamps that successfully conducted magical energy become lamps that maybe looked infused.

findings.evidenceJa: 四十個ばかりのランプを持ち出してきた
findings.governingReading: Rin produces or brings in roughly forty lamps, prompting wonder at how she transported them.
findings.explanation: Rin bringing out about forty lamps becomes “reveals” them.
